termsSections.s1Body: StreamDash Desktop and Android Companion are free, local-first software published by Tenkayro for personal and creator use. Optional StreamDash Pro is a one-time digital license key permanently bound to one (1) Twitch account, non-transferable, and not for resale.
termsSections.s2Body: Pro keys are sold via Payhip (store.tenkayro.de) and delivered immediately upon checkout. Because Pro provides instant digital access, all sales are final and non-refundable once checkout completes or the key is issued/activated, including waiver of statutory withdrawal where permitted by law.
termsSections.s3Body: Hosted services (Cloud Sync, license checks, and ticket portals on streamdash-api.tenkayro.de) are provided as-is and as-available without any uptime SLA. Tenkayro may modify, pause, limit, or permanently discontinue/shut down any servers or Cloud Sync at any time without notice and without any full or partial refund, credit, or compensation. All local StreamDash features continue working offline, and you remain responsible for keeping local profile backups.
termsSections.s4Body: Pro includes 25 MB of Cloud Sync storage (expandable at discretion) strictly for configuration bundles without tokens or chat logs. Abuse, API scraping, reverse engineering, or fraudulent chargebacks may result in immediate key revocation without refund.
termsSections.s5Body: StreamDash is independent from Twitch, OBS, Spotify, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, Payhip, and GitHub. Software and servers are provided as-is without warranties; to the extent permitted by law, liability excludes indirect or consequential damages and is capped at the amount paid for StreamDash Pro.

privacySections.p1Body: Chat logs, events, statistics, commands, and profiles stay locally on your device in SQLite. OAuth tokens, bot credentials, OBS/tip passwords, and license keys remain strictly local in your OS credential store and are never uploaded to Cloud Sync.
privacySections.p2Body: The Android Companion communicates locally over your Wi-Fi with StreamDash Host Mode. Camera permission is used solely on-device for QR pairing (no images stored or uploaded), and optional notifications display alerts forwarded from your PC.
privacySections.p3Body: When activating Pro or syncing, the backend stores your Twitch User ID, username, Key ID/activation status, optional support requests, and uploaded configuration bundles (excluding tokens and chat history). Checkout and invoicing are handled by Payhip.
privacySections.p4Body: You can delete your Cloud Sync backup anytime in Settings > Pro & Cloud or contact Tenkayro via tenkayro.de/contact/ without disclosing private personal details.
